name: Arina Volkova
source:
"With a solid plan and full trust in each other, we could take down the King! I know it!"

Acting as the group's motivator, Arina is a very optimistic and determined girl and a strong believer in the idea that she and the others will be able to escape the castle through enough effort and teamwork. She was the first person to suggest trusting one another as a way to prevent the start of the competition.

That being said, she is unwilling to doubt those around her, and feels a deep sense of love for everyone regardless of their views and stances in relation to her proposed solution. She tends to see the best in others no matter how they may come across, and is consistently kind in all circumstances.

She is a very caring and sweet person whose good-heartedness marks her as one of the most beloved—and trusted—members of the Court.
